fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of the Named Set.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the Named Set, which must be a resource ID segment and unique within all named sets owned by the Router.

fields.label: Router
fields.help: The name of the Cloud Router in which this Named Set will be configured.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: The type of the Named Set.

fields.label: Elements
Expression
fields.help: Textual representation of an expression in Common Expression Language syntax.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: String indicating the location of the expression for error reporting, e.g.
CEL expressions that are comparable to constructs of this set's type.
